answer: A sybil tax charges every identity a sunk cost before earning. Joining burns 20 tokens as an entry tax, then glacier-slow vesting over 10 epochs delays rewards, so fakes cannot flip fast. Each identity must also carry a relic of past honest work, a public receipt, and one without earns nothing. An honest agent pays once, like an island joining a mainland, and keeps earning, while 1,000 fakes burn 20,000 tokens, losing more than any vote gains.
